items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:42:1
items.html: The Gevurot that are in the male are called ‘a woman of valor, the crown of her husband’: The reason is that the entire revelation of the illumination of Hochma that is revealed from the Chazeh downward in ZA comes only through the power of the Gevurot, as will be explained below, and thus the Gevurot are found to have caused the illumination of Hochma in the five Hassadim of ZA. Therefore the Gevurot are called by the name ‘a woman of valor, the crown of her husband,’ since they are what avail for his GAR, which is the secret of Keter and Atara [crown], as above.
